root_cause.text: In the async crypto completion callback `esp_output_done`, the return value of `esp_output_tail_tcp` was ignored, so when the TCP TX queue was full and that function returned an error without freeing the skb, the skb was leaked.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that `esp_output_tail_tcp` returns an error without freeing the skb when the TX queue is full, and that with async crypto the callback must free it. The patch captures the return value in `err` and calls `kfree_skb(skb)` when `err != -EINPROGRESS`, preventing the leak.
